description: PAID $0.04 USDC. One call before you pay, trade with or let through an outside agent, wallet or token: allow / caution / block, a 0-100 trust score and plain-English reasons. Combines Counterparty Check, wallet profile and (for tokens) the token security verdict. Chains base, ethereum, solana. No charge on failure. Returns JSON allow, caution, or block, a 0-100 trust score, and the reasons.

address.description: Agent wallet, token contract, or Solana mint. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters, or a Solana mint. Example: 0x72C80C01fD89Bac74f47cf604b61ACd119c9BCdb. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain of the agent wallet or token. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: base. Allowed values: base, ethereum, solana.

name: trust_agent
title: Trust Bundle: should I trust this agent? ($0.04)
